_notes: Monthly estimates, 2026 rates. The script ignores this key.
Pay: 40,000 kr gross. Danish median for restaurant managers is 40,911 kr (DST via tiderne.dk); Goodjob puts an experienced McDonald's restaurant manager at 40-50k kr.

Tax: Copenhagen municipal 23.39%, bottom tax 12.01% and 8% AM-bidrag; personal allowance 54,100 kr, employment deduction 12.75% (max 63,300 kr), job deduction 3,100 kr. No church tax; below the middle-tax threshold.
Pension: assumed 4% employee share plus 99 kr ATP. A-kasse 500 kr (Ma-kasse lists 562 kr for 2026); it is tax-deductible.
UK student loan: Plan 2, 9% of gross above £29,385. Denmark's 2026-27 overseas threshold is not yet checked against the gov.uk table.
Copenhagen costs: 1-bed rent 12,000 kr (sources say 9,000-13,100), groceries 3,500, heating/power/water 900, monthly pass 460, phone and internet 300, going out 1,500.

UK: £37,000 McDonald's Business Manager base (Glassdoor UK average, Nov 2026), 2026/27 tax and NI, Plan 2, 5% auto-enrolment. UK costs outside London: rent £1,050, council tax £110, energy and water £150, groceries £300, transport £90, phone £50, going out £150.
